page.layout: One page of text in a single column, left. Running head above the text, page number at top right. Signature "b 4" and catchword "stra" at the foot. A small "«" sign stands in the right margin beside the last line.

main_text.p: vetera proferuntur: Fundus Sabinus meus est, eū ego ex iure Quiritiū meū esse aio. item, Quādo te in iure conspicio,&c. De legitimis autē & privatis actionibus, dubitari nisi ab omnium rerum ignaro non potest. Cautiones autem intelligo, in iis rebus gerendis, quibus vitæ societas continetur: ut rerum contrahendarū, emendi, vendendi, locandi, conducendi, societatem coeundi, stipulandi, & si quæ sunt in eodē genere. cuius rei documento locus hic ex libro Ciceronis de Legibus primo esse poterit: Sūmos fuisse in civitate no-«

page.notes: The running head is read as IVRISCONSVLTVS and corrected to IURISCONSULTUS (u/v rule). The "«" in the right margin is a sign, not a word; it is kept as a note. The "ij" in "ijs" is read as "iis" by the vowel rule. The first line continues from the previous page. Text is set in a single paragraph as no indent appears in the body.
